# The C functions and global data of Metal that Apple's online documentation
# lists for macOS: the symbols of Metal.tbd of the full Open SDK, a link stub without headers.
# Apple publishes no source code of Metal, so the names come from its documentation.
# Made by tools/doc_symbols.py (do not edit) from the pages of
# developer.apple.com/documentation, fetched 2026-11-27.
#
# <symbol> <kind> <macOS> <page>
#   kind    func (a function) or data (a variable or constant)
#   macOS   the release that brought it, as the page gives it; - if it gives none
#   page    the page of the symbol, developer.apple.com/documentation/<page>
# The documentation does not say which symbols exist only on one architecture:
# every symbol is for x86_64 and arm64.
